desc.zh: 同一字母的位置永远绑在一起，所以每个字母只能有一个去处；环要借一个空闲字母，而 str2 用满 26 个字母时空闲字母不存在。
desc.en: Copies of a letter move together, so each letter needs one destination; cycles need a spare letter, which cannot exist once str2 uses all 26.

complexity: O(n) time for strings of length n; O(1) auxiliary space (at most 26 map entries and 26 set letters)

concepts.name: Letters move as a block
concepts.description: Positions sharing a letter can never be split, so the letter map must be a function.

concepts.name: Breaking a cycle with a spare letter
concepts.description: Park one letter of a cycle on an unused letter, then run the chain from its end.

concepts.name: Why the 26-letter limit matters
concepts.description: If str2 uses all 26 letters no spare can exist and the first conversion loses a letter for good.
